notes.title: OPEN DEMO VERSION
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42973892/0ccf557df02e78c553f39b6063cd051293a72cb3.png

Demo version
As part of the demo version, all players will be able to go up to the 5th chapter and see the beginning of the storyline. The total passage of the Demo version is from 15 to 20 minutes.

Patch 0.8
Patch number 0.8 will become available, both in the Demo version and for testers of the main build of the game, then it is planned to work on update 0.9 for the main build of the game. You can find out about all the changes in the patch in the previous news.

Rebranding
For those who noticed, the game was previously called "HardCube 2" and was a simple and cute platformer, but due to certain life circumstances of the developer, as well as the lack of profitability of this project, it was decided to make a major change in the game, in addition to a simple visual rebranding , the game also suffered serious internal revisions.

notes.title: Patch Note 0.8
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42973892/1c2328cea5f24b8fe1c8e3aab0933428f4958810.png

Steam Demo Festival
In February, on the 6th of this year, an update will be released under the number 0.8. Below is a list of changes. This patch is dedicated to the February Demo Festival on Steam.

We also want to inform you that along with the release of the update, public access for the Demo version will open.

ADDED/CHANGED:

• Updated version of the engine
• Added support for new version of URP
• Redesigned lighting
• Replaced the character with the final version
• Work has been done on management
• Added new VFX effects
• Fixed some camera triggers
• Added new save checkpoints on levels
• Added a character customization item to the main menu
вЂў Added a stub for the store to the main menu
• Completely redone 1 Biome
• Added 4th level to 1 Biome
• Added option to select game mode
• Adding new puzzles and obstacles
• Animation of the main character with the help of sounds

IN PROGRESS:

• Implementation of the controller
• Work on the points system

Add the game to your wishlist if you haven't already :)
